0022600170.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak and 0-2 on the road) visit the Golden State Warriors (4-3, on a four-game winning streak and 2-1 at home) in the fifth game of the Suns' season, with Phoenix 3rd in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and Golden State 2nd, 1 game back. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), while Golden State is missing Draymond Green (out, rest), Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (out, rest), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. The Suns lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 131-122 win in Phoenix on October 24, though they lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3.
